summary: Phase 72 (Company Centers + Multi-Company Users) e2e tested: 9 backend API tests + full frontend flow. All backend endpoints return correct data, security is enforced (403 on non-member switch / cross-company center create), and frontend flows (Super Admin Center Management, HR company selector, company switcher with role/center scope change, User Memberships dialog) all work end-to-end.

design_issues.screen: HRMS module gate (after HR selects a company)
issues: Dialog missing aria-describedby (Radix warning) — minor a11y

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~22k lines — should be split into modules (centers, memberships, auth) for maintainability.
switch_company sets user.role in DB — good but means concurrent sessions on different companies would clobber each other; consider per-session state instead of mutating the user document.
seed_data_creation: test_super_admin_creates_center_auto_code creates one center prefixed TEST_Center_Phase72 in 3YJW4A and marks it inactive afterwards; also flips access enable/disable on 3YJW4A centers and restores all-enabled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_phase72_centers_multicompany.py. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. HR user is now multi-company so first login lands on /select-company — this is intentional. CompanySwitcher is a Radix dropdown; Playwright needs a normal .click() (not force=True) to open the menu; menu items have data-testid=company-switch-<companyId>.
